items: All-Day Comfort in Effortless Style—Crafted from soft smooth fabric—92% Rayon and 8% Spandex—this long-sleeve set offers comfort and soft stretch for all-day wear. Breathable and temperature-adaptable, it provides a consistently comfortable micro-climate whether you're lounging at home or out and about.

Confident & Practical Fit—Designed to celebrate your shape. The top features feminine side ruching and a slightly cropped length that pairs seamlessly with high-waist pants—elevating your silhouette without being overly revealing. The wide-leg pants complete the look with a chic adjustable drawstring waist and convenient side pockets, perfect for carrying your phone and essentials hands-free.

Versatile & Cross Scenes Ready—It’s the ultimate Working From Home uniform that looks polished enough for video calls. Throw it on with sneakers for running errands or a casual day out. For travel, pair it with a tote for an easy airport look. Great for lounge, travel, business casual settings, the gym, or a workout—it’s your all-in-one fitness and lifestyle staple. Elevate it with simple jewelry for brunch or special events—your capsule wardrobe essential for the cooler season.
Easy Care, Lasting Wear—For best results, machine wash cold in a laundry bag, then lay flat to dry or tumble dry low. Avoid bleach.
Size Guide—Please refer to size chart above the product description for details before purchase.
